page.content:
Tall lieutenant who first meets Robin on a narrow bridge.

How Little John connects

  • Faction: Merry Men — Little John is lieutenant of the Merry Men.
  • Weapon: Quarterstaff — Little John meets Robin with the quarterstaff.
  • Event: Death of Robin Hood — Little John answers the last horn at Kirklees.

What is Little John?

Little John is the band's second: quarterstaff champion, sometimes a sheriff's man in disguise, and the companion who stays to the Kirklees ending.

Key threads lead to Merry Men, Quarterstaff and Death of Robin Hood.
